meta.name: muapi-freeze-effect-video
meta.description: Generate a cinematic "freeze effect" video where time stops mid-scene, the subject walks through the frozen world, then time resumes with a snap.

copy.tagline: 生成电影级时间冻结特效视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想制作时间暂停、主角穿行的酷炫视频片段
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create a cool time-freeze video effect

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的照片和场景描述，生成一段电影感“时间冻结”视频：时间暂停、主角穿过静止世界、响指后恢复。
howto.when: 当你提到“冻结效果”、“时间暂停视频”等关键词，或直接要求制作一段时间冻结视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一段时间冻结视频，主角用我上传的照片。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供照片和场景等参数。

say.text: 做一个酒吧里的冻结效果视频，冻结瞬间是啤酒洒在空中。
say.note: Claude 会使用你提供的场景和冻结瞬间描述。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a cinematic "freeze effect" video based on your photo and scene description: time stops, the subject walks through the frozen world, then time resumes with a snap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "freeze effect", "time freeze video", or directly ask to create a time-freeze video.

say_en.text: Create a freeze effect video with my uploaded photo as the main character.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for photo and scene parameters.

say_en.text: Make a freeze effect video in a bar, with beer suspended in midair.
say_en.note: Claude will use your scene and freeze moment description.
